en: This is a vintage postcard with handwritten text in a cursive style. There is a green postage stamp from Norway (marked 'Norge') in the upper right corner, valued at 5 øre. The postcard is postmarked 'Kristiania', which is the historical name for Oslo, the capital of Norway. The date on the postmark is 20.8.12, which likely refers to August 20, 1912. The card is addressed to 'Fru Astrid Weflen, Bærumsminde, Pensionat - Espen St.' and has additional handwritten correspondence in Norwegian on the left side.
